body.purpose: Ant Design default UI type for conversation, rail, composer, and controls.

label.purpose: 12px timestamps, header subtitle, Spoken caption, connection/profile.

shadows.name: composer
shadows.purpose: Lift the sticky composer shell above the conversation pane.

motion.name: reduced-scroll
motion.purpose: Honor prefers-reduced-motion; do not invent decorative motion.

components.name: Send
components.description: Primary 32px send control with 6px radius. Icon is optically nudged 1px.
components.html: <button class="ds-send" type="button" aria-label="Send"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2.01 21 23 12 2.01 3 2 10l15 2-15 2z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-send { width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--ac-color-primary, #1677ff); color: #fff; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-send svg { display: block; transform: translate(1px, -1px); } .ds-send:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ac-color-primary, #1677ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-send:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; filter: none; }

components.name: Composer shell
components.description: Elevated message well: Model chip (Dropdown catalog + reasoning footer), attach, field, voice, send. Stays visible in voice. Reasoning level is secondary text inside the Model button. Compact 8px shell plus 8px control inner padding (same as session rows) so Message and Model text share one edge.
components.html: Attach
components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--ac-color-elevated, #1f1f1f); border: 1px solid var(--ac-color-border, #303030); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); color: var(--ac-color-text, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88)); font: 400 14px/1.57 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-composer-field { border: 0; resize: none; min-height: 1.5em; padding: 8px; background: transparent; color: inherit; caret-color: var(--ac-color-text, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88)); font: inherit; } .ds-composer-field::placeholder { color: var(--ac-color-text-secondary, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)); } .ds-composer-field:focus { outline: none; } .ds-composer-bar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; min-height: 32px; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-model { height: auto; min-height: 32px; padding: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-model:hover { background: var(--ac-color-fill, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)); } .ds-ghost { color: var(--ac-color-text-secondary, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)); font-size: 14px; } .ds-send { width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--ac-color-primary, #1677ff); }

components.name: User bubble
components.description: Right-aligned user turn. Assistant copy stays open Markdown, not a bubble.
components.css: .ds-user-turn { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; max-width: 36rem; margin-inline-start: auto; font: 400 14px/1.57 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-meta { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ac-color-text-secondary, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)); } .ds-user-bubble { padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--ac-color-bubble, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)); color: var(--ac-color-text, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88)); border-radius: 18px; white-space: pre-wrap; }

components.name: Spoken
components.description: Secondary public speech text under the same assistant turn when it differs from display Markdown. Compact 8px rhythm; not a second bubble.
components.html:
♪ Spoken

Hello. How can I help you today?
components.css: .ds-spoken { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--ac-color-border, #303030); font: 400 14px/1.57 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-spoken-caption { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ac-color-text-tertiary, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45)); } .ds-spoken-body { margin: 0; color: var(--ac-color-text-secondary, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)); white-space: pre-wrap; }

components.name: Interrupted chip
components.description: Solid Ant Design Tag for interrupted or failed turns; never a full-width banner.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; width: max-content; max-width: 100%; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: #d48806; color: #fff; font: 600 12px/22px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-status-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Session row
components.description: Catalog row: title + time, fill hover across the overflow control, no outline.
components.css: .ds-session-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--ac-color-text, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88)); font: 400 14px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-session-row:hover, .ds-session-row:focus-within { background: var(--ac-color-fill, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)); } .ds-session-open { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; text-align: start; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-session-open time { flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ac-color-text-secondary, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)); } .ds-session-open:hover, .ds-session-open:focus-visible, .ds-overflow:hover, .ds-overflow:focus-visible { background: transparent; border: 0; outline: none; box-shadow: none; } .ds-overflow { width: 24px; height: 24px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: New chat
components.description: Text control aligned to the Agent Core left edge; fill hover, no divider rule.
components.css: .ds-new-chat { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: auto; padding: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--ac-color-text, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88)); font: 500 14px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-plus { width: 16px; text-align: center; } .ds-new-chat:hover, .ds-new-chat:focus-visible { background: var(--ac-color-fill, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)); border: 0; box-shadow: none; outline: none; }

narrative.overview:
Agent Core is a personal-chat operate surface. Ant Design v6 is the MVP component system. Impeccable refines layout, spacing, composition, hierarchy, and polish while preserving AntD primitives. ChatGPT/Codex are UX and hierarchy references for the conversational experience (quiet session rail, centered reading column, user bubbles, open assistant Markdown, bottom composer with Model/Reasoning, in-flow activity)—not a component dependency or pixel clone.

The default appearance is Ant Design darkAlgorithm: black layout, #141414 conversation, #1f1f1f elevated composer/code, and #1677ff for primary actions. Product CSS maps those roles; it does not invert the former light palette.
keyCharacteristics: Ant Design v6 darkAlgorithm with Sider theme light so chat surfaces stay black, not navy admin
ChatGPT/Codex are layout/hierarchy references only; no second kit or pixel clone
Compact/default/section spacing (8/12/16px) owns shells and sibling gap; Ant Design paddingXS (8px, same as session rows) owns text-control inner padding
Composer owns Model (reasoning level inside the Model button when supported) with Attach/Voice/Send; header owns Speech locale
Spoken is a secondary inset on the same assistant turn, not a second chat entry

rules.name: Direct AntD Rule
rules.body: Import antd in product components. Do not invent a design-system wrapper.

rules.name: Docs Win Rule
rules.body: DESIGN.md is lightweight presentation only. /docs owns screens and behavior.

rules.name: Role Surfaces Rule
rules.body: Map dark roles in product CSS. Do not invert the former light palette.

rules.name: Half-Pane Reply Rule
rules.body: After a user send, leave about half the conversation pane for the incoming reply so prior turns can stay in view.

rules.name: Compact Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Shells, docks, and sibling gap use compact/default/section (8/12/16px). Do not invent extra --ac-space-* steps or 2px CSS gaps.

rules.name: Additive Inset Rule
rules.body: A padded shell owns the outer inset. Composer and Model overlay shells use compact 8px. Nested text controls keep Ant Design paddingXS (8px, same as session-row body) via theme.useToken(). Align labels by giving equivalent children the same inner padding. Never zero a text button's padding or use negative margin to grow hover fill.

dos: Do import antd components in feature files; keep ConfigProvider at the app root with darkAlgorithm.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion; keep labeled errors and visible focus.
Do keep the session rail 280px at 1200px and above, 240px from 768–1199px, and an Ant Design Drawer below 768px.
Do fill session-row hover with the fill token only, including the overflow control.
Do leave about half the conversation pane below a user send for the incoming reply.
Do put Model in the composer when the composer is shown (reasoning level inside the Model button when supported); keep Speech locale in the header and new-chat Identity stack.

Do use compact/default/section for shells and sibling gap, and Ant Design paddingXS via theme.useToken() for text-control inner padding so Message and Model labels share one edge and match session-row inset.
Do compose Model and catalog rows with Ant Design Button type=text and Flex; keep app.css for shell chrome and ring suppression only.
Do render Spoken only when public speechText differs from display text; keep it secondary on the same turn.
Do preserve testids connection and profile.
Do keep the labeled composer available while voice is live until /docs and tests change together.
donts: Don't reproduce Pixel Dialogue Field, Obsidian Mint, Martian Mono, field textures, presence plates, or custom Select.
Don't add generic wrapper libraries, Ant Design Pro/ProComponents/X, or another CSS framework.
Don't use Layout.Sider theme dark (navy admin sider).
Don't treat DESIGN.md as behavioral authority over /docs.
Don't use a blocking Modal or a second Select/button for model or effort; keep one Dropdown on the Model chip with effort in the overlay footer.
Don't put Model in both the empty Identity stack and the composer.
Don't zero a text control's padding, use negative margin, or stack extra child padding to fake alignment with a sibling.
Don't show Spoken as another conversational turn or from internal generated tails.
